title: Drill down from follow-up status totals to scoped details
description: A user clicks an overdue, today or upcoming total in the dynamic follow-up due designer and sees the matching authorized detail page. The click sets only a finite due-status filter, resets to page one, retains customer, keyword, as-of, ahead-days, selected fields and grouping, and invokes the existing server preview. Show active status and provide a clear way back to all statuses; preserve denied, validation, empty and network feedback. No client-side raw data cache, arbitrary SQL, business write or permission expansion; existing preview audit remains in force. Development only: no schema or migration edits, production SQL or real database execution, secrets, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused UI contract tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Each status total opens page one with only the finite matching due-status filter while retaining all other selected fields and filters.
The active drill-down state and return-to-all control are clear; empty, denied, validation and network states remain visible with safe text rendering.
Focused UI contract tests cover status choice, reset, retained filters and errors; safe Release build/test passes.
